description:
The Large Exercise Mat is engineered for high-intensity training. Its high-density, non-toxic foam absorbs impact, protects your joints and floors, and keeps you stable during jumps, squats and burpees. At 6.6' x 4' (200 x 120 cm) it offers more length than a standard mat, so tall athletes can deadlift, do yoga flows and stretch without your heels leaving the surface.

The 10mm (0.4") thickness cushions knees and wrists during floor work, yet stays firm enough that balance poses and equipment stay planted. The surface is easy to wipe clean and resists odor, and the dense foam holds its shape workout after workout.
